tool_input.command: echo "=== pwd ===" && pwd && echo "=== ls ===" && ls -la && echo "=== data ===" && ls -la data/ && echo "=== head features ===" && head -20 data/features.csv && echo "=== wc ===" && wc -l data/features.csv

echo "=== schema ===" && cat data/schema.md && echo "" && echo "=== unique dates ===" && cut -d',' -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort -u && echo "=== entities per day approx ===" && cut -d',' -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== env ===" && echo "HOST=$HOPSWORKS_HOST" && echo "KEY set: ${HOPSWORKS_API_KEY:+yes}" && echo "=== help ===" && hops --help 2>&1 | head -100
echo "=== fg create ===" && hops fg create --help 2>&1 && echo "" && echo "=== fg insert ===" && hops fg insert --help 2>&1 && echo "" && echo "=== fg stats ===" && hops fg stats --help 2>&1
echo "=== context ===" && hops context 2>&1 | head -40 && echo "" && echo "=== sql help ===" && hops sql --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show project context and sql help

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg create drift_features \
  --primary-key entity_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --features "entity_id:string,event_time:timestamp,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double" \
  --description "Daily feature observations for drift investigation" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -30
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg insert drift_features --file data/features.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -30

cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg delete drift_features --version 1 --json 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== recreate ===" && hops fg create drift_features \
  --primary-key entity_id \
  --features "entity_id:string,event_time:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double" \
  --description "Daily feature observations for drift investigation" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Delete and recreate FG with string event_time

tool_input.command: cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg insert drift_features --file data/features.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -15

cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) AS d, count(*) n, round(avg(f1),3) f1, round(avg(f2),3) f2, round(avg(f3),3) f3, round(avg(f4),3) f4, round(avg(f5),3) f5, round(avg(f6),3) f6 FROM drift_features GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d" --json -q 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Test SQL query for daily means

tool_input.command: cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify sql "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) AS d, count(*) n, round(avg(f1),3) f1, round(avg(f2),3) f2, round(avg(f3),3) f3, round(avg(f4),3) f4, round(avg(f5),3) f5, round(avg(f6),3) f6 FROM drift_features GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d" --json -q 2>&1 | tail -8
cd "$(pwd)" && echo "=== catalogs ===" && hops --no-verify trino catalogs --json -q 2>&1 | tail -20

cd "$(pwd)" && echo "=== hive schemas ===" && hops --no-verify trino tables hive.mlpab0497bc --json -q 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "=== try hive ===" && hops --no-verify trino schemas hive --json -q 2>&1 | tail -20
cd "$(pwd)" && echo "=== hive.featurestore tables ===" && hops --no-verify trino tables hive.mlpab0497bc_featurestore --json -q 2>&1 | tail -20

cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify trino query "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) AS d, round(avg(f1),3) f1m, round(stddev(f1),3) f1s, round(avg(f2),3) f2m, round(stddev(f2),3) f2s, round(avg(f3),3) f3m, round(stddev(f3),3) f3s, round(avg(f4),3) f4m, round(stddev(f4),3) f4s, round(avg(f5),3) f5m, round(stddev(f5),3) f5s, round(avg(f6),3) f6m, round(stddev(f6),3) f6s FROM hive.mlpab0497bc_featurestore.drift_features_1 GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d" --json -q 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "^$"
tool_input.description: Compute daily mean/std per feature via Trino

tool_input.command: cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify trino query "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) AS d, round(avg(f1),3) f1m, round(stddev(f1),3) f1s, round(avg(f2),3) f2m, round(stddev(f2),3) f2s, round(avg(f3),3) f3m, round(stddev(f3),3) f3s, round(avg(f4),3) f4m, round(stddev(f4),3) f4s, round(avg(f5),3) f5m, round(stddev(f5),3) f5s, round(avg(f6),3) f6m, round(stddev(f6),3) f6s FROM delta.mlpab0497bc_featurestore.drift_features_1 GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d" --json -q 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "compatibility" | grep -v "Logged in"
cd "$(pwd)" && mkdir -p submission && printf '{"feature": "f6", "onset": "2026-02-28"}\n' > submission/answers.json && cat submission/answers.json
